# defectdojo_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo user by ID or username, for example to give it access to a product or name it as a product's contact. Reading users needs a superuser, or the configuration permissions for users; reading `configuration_permissions` needs a superuser; without one, it is null when the user has permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_user" "by_username" {
  username = "jdoe"
}

data "defectdojo_user" "by_id" {
  id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the user to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `username` must be set.
- `username` (String) The username of the user to look up, compared exactly, case included. Exactly one of `id` and `username` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `configuration_permissions` (Set of String) The codenames of the user's configuration permissions, which grant global rights, such as `add_product_type` or `change_sla_configuration`. Which codenames exist depends on DefectDojo's version and system settings: the `*_jira_instance` permissions exist only with Jira enabled, `*_github_conf` only with GitHub, and `*_engagement_survey` and `*_question` only with questionnaires; `*_tool_type` and `*_tool_configuration` go away with DefectDojo 3.6.
- `date_joined` (String) When the user was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the user.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user can sign in.
- `is_staff` (Boolean) Whether the user is staff.
- `is_superuser` (Boolean) Whether the user is a superuser.
- `last_login` (String) When the user last signed in to the UI, in RFC 3339 format, or null if never.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the user.
